metadata.name: Alignment Matrix
metadata.description: A compact, interactive React matrix for comparing ideas, products, or directions across two editable axes. Add names, place and drag points, adjust positions with a keyboard, and optionally use local images. Includes a responsive demo with light and dark themes.
metadata.author: blackbambu
